name: RefCOCO: Referring Expression Comprehension on Common Objects in Context
description: RefCOCO is a referring expression comprehension and grounding dataset built on MS COCO images using a two-player reference game interface. Introduced by UNC Chapel Hill researchers in ECCV 2016, the standard UNC split contains 142,209 referring expressions for 50,000 objects across 19,994 images with separated test sets for persons (testA) and non-human objects (testB).
